AUTH-0001.title: One-click admin sign-in reaches the operator console
AUTH-0001.objective: Confirm the pre-created admin account can sign in with the one-click card and lands on the Overview screen with admin privileges.
AUTH-0001.precondition: Dev server reachable; the browser has no existing session (fresh context / signed out).

steps.name: Open the dashboard
steps.expected: The login screen is shown with the one-click admin sign-in option.
steps.actual: Login screen shown with the one-click admin sign-in card (Sign in as Admin / admin@advance-seeds.demo).

steps.name: Sign in as admin
steps.expected: The user is signed in and the Overview screen is shown, with the account shown as admin in the top bar.
steps.actual: Signed in and landed on Overview; top bar shows admin@advance-seeds.demo / ADMIN role badge.

AUTH-0002.title: Manual sign-in with valid admin credentials reaches the operator console
AUTH-0002.objective: Confirm a user can bypass the one-click shortcut and sign in with the admin's own email and password.
AUTH-0002.precondition: Dev server reachable; the browser has no existing session (fresh context / signed out).

steps.name: Switch to manual sign-in
steps.expected: An email and password form is shown in place of the one-click card.
steps.actual: Use a different account clicked; email/password manual form is shown in place of the one-click card.

steps.name: Enter the admin's email and password and submit
steps.expected: The user is signed in and the Overview screen is shown.
steps.actual: Signed in with QA_ADMIN_EMAIL/PASSWORD (demo mode); landed on Overview screen.

AUTH-0003.title: Manual sign-in with an incorrect password is rejected
AUTH-0003.objective: Confirm an incorrect password is rejected with a visible error and the user stays on the login screen.
AUTH-0003.precondition: Dev server reachable; the browser has no existing session (fresh context / signed out).

steps.name: Switch to manual sign-in
steps.expected: The email and password form is shown.

steps.name: Enter a valid email with an incorrect password and submit
steps.expected: An error message is shown, the login screen remains, and no session is created.
steps.actual: Wrong password submitted: red 'Invalid demo admin credentials.' error shown, login screen remains, no session created.

AUTH-0004.title: Sign out returns to the login screen
AUTH-0004.objective: Confirm signing out ends the session and returns the user to the unauthenticated login screen.
AUTH-0004.precondition: User is already signed in as admin.

steps.name: Sign in as admin
steps.actual: Signed in as admin; Overview screen shown.

steps.name: Sign out
steps.expected: The login screen is shown again and the previously visible account/session details are gone.
steps.actual: Signed out; back on the unauthenticated login screen, no account/session details visible.
